title: Vergrim
html:
Vergrim & Seer Brood

Vergrim (Vergrim's Vexation) Level 30-50

Vergrim is a mage who is protected by two blademaster champions, Rattle Tooth's DJ and Rattle Toe's Personal Masseur. He also summons Whisker Broodlings that turn red and blow up, causing damage and knocking you down.

This fight may be more difficult for a solo mage since ranged magic attacks will usually hit his summons instead of him, and he moves away to avoid area attacks. A Vergrim Killer Mage build using Shadow Lightning at max level is the best way for a mage to go for him, as it will jump to the Champions too.

Skills:

  • Seer Brood Sacrifice (knockdown, fire damage)
  • Summon Seer Brood
  • Divine Bolt (divine damage)
  • Guards Buff (Regen, fire resist, poison resist)

Resistances:

  • Good Poison Resist
  • Good Fire Resist
  • No Ice Resist
  • Low Shadow Resist
  • No Divine Resist

Support

Vergrim has two guards (Blademaster Heroes), Rattle Tooth's DJ and Rattle Toe's Personal Masseur.

For tips on fighting Vergrim, check out the Vergrim Boss Guide.
